caption: The drawing shows a single wooden table with a rectangular shape and beveled corners. The tabletop has an inset oval panel in the center, depicted with a slightly different, lighter brown color. There is one central drawer on the front side, featuring two ornate keyholes and metal handles. The table is supported by four turned, baluster-style legs that are darker at the narrow middle sections and topped and bottomed by rounded forms. Beneath the legs, there are two intersecting X-shaped stretchers with a central round finial at the crossing point. The table is rendered primarily in shades of brown, with the hardware and embellishments drawn in a lighter, metallic hue. The entire object is centered on a light beige background with a faint rectangular border around the drawing. The artist’s signature is present in the lower left corner.
title: Slate-top Table
